title: Two pointers: a pair with sum 15

frames.note: Find two values that add up to 15. Start at both ends
1 + 15 = 16 > 15: too big. a[j] cannot pair with anything, so move j left
1 + 11 = 12 < 15: too small. a[i] cannot pair with anything, so move i right
2 + 11 = 13 < 15: too small. a[i] cannot pair with anything, so move i right
